Actually, I don't agree with this.

Psychedelics are a very powerful thing that have the potential to both unlock great potential or great darkness within your mind. Acid is especially potent and has a very real possibility of aggravating a pre-existing psychological condition that you may not even be aware of. Even without that risk, there is always the very real risk of you finding something out about yourself or the world that you simply can't come to grips with, and it may or may not even be true.

There is a strong misconception that psychedelics give you all the answers, when really all they do is open your eyes so that you can find the answers on your own. If you're still looking in the wrong places or you refuse to accept the reality presented to you or you lack the emotional and psychological stability and fortitude to understand it, you will learn nothing and may end up more confused than you were before you started.

It takes a great deal of discipline to put psychedelics to proper use if you want to actually gain anything meaningful from the experience beyond watching the walls breathe and drip geometric patterns for 6 hours. A great deal of people don't have that, and many never will.
